_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We operate, franchise, or license 6,080 properties worldwide, with 1,190,604 rooms as of year-end 2016'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel properties and home and apartment sharing services for customers'; 'Economic uncertainty could continue to impact our financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business'; 'Our 2016 results reflected a year-over-year increase in the number of properties in our system, favorable demand for our brands in many markets around the world, and slow but steady economic growth'; and 'On September 23, 2016 (the “Merger Date”), we completed the acquisition of Starwood Hotels & Resorts Worldwide, LLC, formerly known as Starwood Hotels & Resorts Worldwide, Inc.' ... 'Our combined company now operates or franchises over 6,000 properties with nearly 1.2 million rooms' (its own FY2016 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We operate, franchise, or license 6,080 properties worldwide, with 1,190,604 rooms as of year-end 2016'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel properties and home and apartment sharing services for customers'; 'Economic uncertainty could continue to impact our financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business'; 'Our 2016 results reflected a year-over-year increase in the number of properties in our system, favorable demand for our brands in many markets around the world, and slow but steady economic growth'; and 'On September 23, 2016 (the “Merger Date”), we completed the acquisition of Starwood Hotels & Resorts Worldwide, LLC, formerly known as Starwood Hotels & Resorts Worldwide, Inc.' ... 'Our combined company now operates or franchises over 6,000 properties with nearly 1.2 million rooms' (its own FY2016 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.40x; +35% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.97; conservative 2yr +138%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -37.6%/yr (worst year FY07-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +64.1%/yr (Q2 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +64.1%/yr (FY07-FY16 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +64.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2017-07-21) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.40x (70.8% downside to Bear $30 / +178.1% upside to Bull $286) | Adj composite 2.45 vs market 1.48: gap +0.97 [UNDERVALUED] | +35% above the EPP floor $76 (19x FY17E $4.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +138.1% total (+69.0%/yr) | At 25.7x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $136 sits at or below the BASE case; North American RevPAR +4.0% in Q1 2017, forward fee revenue +59.22-62.14% (Q2 2017 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
